from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and assigned legal cause category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as it appears")
    category: Literal['海事海商纠纷', '执行案由-对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议', '行政行为-行政复议', '渎职罪', '产品责任纠纷', '行政行为-行政裁决'] = Field(description="The legal cause category assigned to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
